videos.title: 🟨 COMPLETE GUIDE to the APOTHEOSIS MOD in MINECRAFT
Everything You Need To Know About Apotheosis (Full Guide - 1.21+)

human_notes._shape: NOT an item ladder. Apotheosis is an affix/loot/enchanting SYSTEM: rarity tiers, affixes on dropped gear, gem sockets, reforging and an enchanting rework. Guides spend their time on how the system works, not on a crafting chain, and quests should follow that. The item ids below are the system's tools, not a progression sequence.
order: The enchanting rework comes first, because it is what the player meets first. Guide: 'the first thing we will do is complete the enchanting system.' That means bookshelves around a vanilla enchanting table, not any Apotheosis machine.

Bookshelves before anything else: apotheosis:stoneshelf / apotheosis:seashelf / apotheosis:hellshelf / apotheosis:deepshelf / apotheosis:endshelf / apotheosis:melonshelf / apotheosis:beeshelf are the base tier, and each raises a different stat.

Then INFUSE those shelves, which is done at the enchanting table itself with minimum stat requirements: apotheosis:infused_seashelf, apotheosis:infused_hellshelf, apotheosis:infused_deepshelf, apotheosis:infused_endshelf. Guide: 'we'd enchant them on an infusion table which requires certain minimums... Why do we want them infused? This allows us to upgrade to Glowing and Crystalline.'

Upgraded shelves are the real goal of the enchanting arc: apotheosis:glowing_hellshelf, apotheosis:blazing_hellshelf, apotheosis:crystal_seashelf, apotheosis:heart_seashelf, apotheosis:pearl_endshelf, apotheosis:draconic_endshelf, apotheosis:echoing_deepshelf, apotheosis:soul_touched_deepshelf, and the endgame apotheosis:library / apotheosis:ender_library.

Gem handling starts as soon as loot starts dropping: apotheosis:gem_dust is the single most-repeated item in the guides (12 mentions, 9 in praising context). Guide: 'the first time we get gem dust, it has to be this way.'
Reforging comes after there is loot worth improving: apotheosis:simple_reforging_table then apotheosis:reforging_table, plus apotheosis:salvaging_table to feed it.
apotheosis:augmenting_table and the boss content (apotheosis:boss_summoner, apotheosis:prismatic_altar) are late.
gates: Enchanting is gated on three stats, not on level alone: Eterna, Quanta and Arcana, each supplied by shelves. Guide names them as the basics of the whole mod. An infusion has explicit minimums - guide: 'An echoing shelf requires an Echo Shard and a Deep Shelf... It requires 30 Eterna, 40% Quanta and 40% Arcana.'
apotheosis:rectifier, apotheosis:rectifier_t2, apotheosis:rectifier_t3 exist purely to bend Quanta's randomness - they are the stat-shaping gate between 'can enchant' and 'can enchant reliably'.

Both the reforging table and the augmenting table need consumable FUEL, which blocks spamming them. Guide: 'first of all it requires fuel. The fuel is essentially the sigil of rebirth' and 'the Augmentation table requires its own fuel, just like the reforging table does.'

Reforging is gated by rarity-matched materials: apotheosis:common_material, apotheosis:uncommon_material, apotheosis:rare_material, apotheosis:epic_material, apotheosis:mythic_material, apotheosis:ancient_material. You cannot reforge above the material you can supply.
Sockets are gated by apotheosis:sigil_of_socketing - gems do nothing without a socket to sit in.
mechanics: Rarity ladder, verified in the jar rather than taken from a video: common -> uncommon -> rare -> epic -> mythic -> ancient. Every gem file in data/apotheosis/gems carries a bonus value for exactly those six keys, so rarity is a numeric multiplier on the same effect (e.g. the ballast gem gives +1 attack damage at common and +10 at ancient).
Affix items are dropped, not crafted. Rarity determines both how strong the item is and which affixes it may roll - that is the whole loot loop, and no recipe scan will ever surface it.

Gems: apotheosis:gem is a single item whose identity lives in NBT; the ~50 gem variants are datapack registry entries under data/apotheosis/gems/... (core/ballast, the_nether/inferno, twilight/queen and so on), NOT separate item ids. A gem variant written in resource-location form (the apotheosis namespace followed by a gems/... subpath) is a model/registry path, not an item, and must never become a quest target.
apotheosis:gem_cutting_table plus apotheosis:gem_dust upgrade a gem's rarity; apotheosis:gem_fused_slate and apotheosis:star_cube are the higher-tier socket/gem inputs.

Sigils are the item-editing verbs: apotheosis:sigil_of_socketing (add socket), apotheosis:sigil_of_rebirth (reforge fuel), apotheosis:sigil_of_enhancement, apotheosis:sigil_of_unnaming, apotheosis:sigil_of_withdrawal (pull a gem back out).

Enchantment tomes move enchantments around rather than adding them: apotheosis:scrap_tome -> apotheosis:improved_scrap_tome, plus slot-specific apotheosis:weapon_tome / apotheosis:helmet_tome / apotheosis:chestplate_tome / apotheosis:leggings_tome / apotheosis:boots_tome / apotheosis:bow_tome / apotheosis:pickaxe_tome / apotheosis:fishing_tome / apotheosis:other_tome, and apotheosis:extraction_tome. Guide: 'Superior Scrapping comes from infusing a Tomb of Scrapping.'
Apotheosis also raises vanilla enchantment max levels - the guide demonstrates converting Sharpness 1 into Sharpness 3 once level 8 is unlocked, which is a mechanic, not an item.
Guides also talk about 'world tier' progression and affix-mob farms as the main way to actually obtain good gear.
traps: Low-rarity affix gear is disposable. Guide: 'I am going to break it, because it is useless' - salvage it at apotheosis:salvaging_table rather than reforging it.
Do not build a crafting-chain quest line for this mod. There is no chain: the interesting items are dropped with random affixes, and a quest that says 'craft an epic sword' cannot be satisfied.
Do not treat gem variants as items (see mechanics) - this is the exact mistake the fixed jar_ids() was emitting.
